content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to transfer my [product_name] files to the SD card but haven't been successful. My remote PC can access the subnet 10.10.45.0/24, while my own network is on 172.2.8.0/24. Uploading the [product_name] PLC program works fine, but the web files from [product_name] Web Editor don't upload. The connection test displays a green status, yet I'm told upload isn't possible because the PC isn't on the same subnet. Is there a way to bypass this restriction or a port that needs to be opened on the router?

Remote access to the webserver and custom webpages is supported, but project uploads must be performed locally. The [product_name] Web Editor project can only be transferred to the MSD card when you are on-site and can't be done remotely.

analysis.insight_summary: A key limitation affects users attempting to upload web files made with [product_name] Web Editor to the SD card of a [product_name] PLC across different subnets. Standard PLC program uploads work remotely, but web file uploads are denied if the PC isn't on the same subnet, causing confusion when the initial connection test succeeds. The official guidance confirms this is a product restriction: web projects must be loaded in person.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to remotely upload [product_name] Web Editor web projects to the SD card of a [product_name] PLC, mirroring the process for PLC programs, and is searching for a method or specific network setup to make this possible.
